properties.description: Propene-ethene van der Waals pre-reaction complex (single dot-joined complex node), 0 imaginary frequencies; loose encounter complex, C1...C4 = 3.86 A; binding energy -2.61 kcal/mol vs the separated monomers.
Concerted suprafacial Alder-ene saddle: H6 transfer C3->C5 (dominant 0.766), C3-H6 breaking, C1...C4 bond formation, C1=C2/C2=C3 pi shift. Exactly one imaginary frequency (-1156.36 cm-1).
Pent-1-ene (CH2=CH-CH2-CH2-CH3), the IRC forward endpoint re-optimized; 0 imaginary frequencies. A second pent-1-ene conformer at -196.410332397 Ha is min/pent1ene_optfreq.log (0.69 kcal/mol higher).

Extra investigated C5H10 isomer (pent-2-ene), 0 imaginary frequencies. NOT connected to the IRC path and NOT the ene adduct; recorded only because it is the more stable C5H10 isomer (3.35 kcal/mol below pent-1-ene) and was examined as a possible alternative product.
